vars.feature: a dash. An input with Dash true makes the glimmer move at three times its speed for 5 ticks, the tick of the press included, and it cannot dash again until 45 ticks after the press (a press during either is ignored). Sim.Step does it from the input's Dash (a new bool property of SimInput, "dash" on the wire, which SimInput.ToWire writes), so the server and a client's prediction move alike; the Fighter keeps its dash state, which travels in snapshots (Fighter.ToArray and FromArray), and the server keeps "dash" when it cleans an input (Sim.Sanitize). ArenaClient.Step takes it as a sixth argument dash (false by default) and sends it, so a dash online needs no correction
